request.description: Attempt to self-register as an admin. Should return 400 Bad Request and error code PUBLIC_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT_NOT_ALLOWED.
Owner attempts to modify restaurant billingStatus to upgrade subscription. Should return 400 Bad Request with error code BILLING_STATUS_NOT_OWNER_EDITABLE.
Employee of restaurant A attempts to add stamps for restaurant B. Should return 403 Forbidden with error code EMPLOYEE_RESTAURANT_MISMATCH.
Owner attempts to modify workflow system-controlled fields (e.g. systemState of placed). Should return 400 Bad Request with error code WORKFLOW_SYSTEM_FIELD_IMMUTABLE.

request.description: Owner disables the served step. Should succeed with 200 OK and increment orderWorkflowVersion.
Owner attempts to save workflow where placed is not the first enabled step. Should return 400 Bad Request with error INVALID_ORDER_WORKFLOW_BOUNDARY.
Owner attempts to save step.order as float 1.5. Should return 400 Bad Request with error INVALID_ORDER_WORKFLOW_ORDER.
Customer attempts to check in with poor accuracy (200m). Should fail with LOCATION_ACCURACY_TOO_LOW.
Creates an order using verified OrderSession and fresh geofence reading. Returns 201.
Customer gets their own active or history orders list.
Retrieves details of a single order owned by the customer.

query.description: Optional: Filter by specific restaurant owned by the owner

request.description: Restaurant owner retrieves the active order queue. Bypasses staff role visibility filters. Supports optional restaurantId filtering.
Active staff gets restaurant preparation queue. Returns oldest-first.
Assigned waiter advances the order from PLACED to SERVED. Automatically records service.servedAt server timestamp and transitions systemState to IN_PROGRESS.
Assigned waiter advances the order from SERVED to COMPLETED. Operational completion is independent of payment status.
Staff overrides and cancels the order ticket.
